demonstrates: Optic() from-scratch construction: surfaces.add(index/radius/thickness/material/is_stop), set_aperture(EPD), fields.set_type('angle'), fields.add, wavelengths.add(is_primary), draw. Also records the 0.6.0 -> 0.7.0 deprecation of the tutorial's Optic.add_* API.

Optic.add_wavelength is deprecated and will be removed in v0.7.0; use optic.wavelengths.add() instead.
Optic.set_field_type is deprecated and will be removed in v0.7.0; use optic.fields.set_type() instead.

notes: Optic.draw3D() is deliberately NOT executed: it blocks forever in the headless agent_solver container (VTK finds no X server, no EGL and no OSMesa). Recorded in failure_guide.md.
